answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the mirror of a task receipt, and the oasis is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
